title: Riglane Spec Index (_index.json)
description: Per-scope engine-owned catalog at .riglane/specs/<scope>/_index.json. Engine-DERIVED from spec frontmatter at spec_write (à la agent-notes) — never hand-written by the agent. Answers 'what specs/domains do we have' (catalog + search hints). Design: sub_tasks/spec-system-revision/design/index-registry.md §1.

version.description: Schema version. Starts at 1 — a clean-v1 engine-owned schema, NOT a continuation of the legacy sequence. Old files differ by shape (domains group, mappings object), not version.

scope.description: The scope this index belongs to (e.g. generic, or a declared scope). Equals the directory it lives in.

domains.description: Domain registry for this scope. name is the spec_id prefix; description powers connotation + domain dedup.

specs.description: One entry per committed spec in this scope. Derived from spec frontmatter by the engine.

domainEntry.description: A domain within this scope. name is the full short domain word (spec_id prefix); description is a one-liner used for connotation + domain dedup; next_serial is the high-water minting counter.

name.description: Full short domain word, e.g. auth. lowercase, prefer one word, max ~2 hyphenated.

description.description: One-line description of the domain (from domain_description on the introducing spec).

next_serial.description: High-water serial counter (index-registry §1.1a). Next spec in this domain mints <domain>-<next_serial>, then next_serial++. delete does NOT decrement it — a retired id is never reused (identity stability). Safety-guard: reconciled up to highest_existing+1 if desynced.

specIndexEntry.description: Catalog entry for one spec. spec_id/domain/title/summary/applies_to are copied from the spec frontmatter by the engine; path/dates/content_fingerprint are engine-owned.

summary.description: Mandatory hint — copied verbatim from spec frontmatter. Discriminator in spec_search results + scannability on full-index read.

applies_to.description: Authorial intent-of-scope (areas/components/patterns). Powers area-search + dedup topology.

path.description: Spec file path relative to project root, e.g. .riglane/specs/generic/auth/auth-001.md.

content_fingerprint.description: Engine-derived fingerprint of the spec's managed content (Rule Statement), for the summary staleness guard (index-registry §1.4). Exact covered range confirmed at Phase II. Form: sha256:<hex>.
